overview_title: # From Pilots to Agents: How US Banks Talk About AI (2019–2026)
overview_intro:
US banks that sell shares must publish an annual report, the **10-K**. We read these reports from **2019 to 2026** and ask:

> **How fast did AI enter the language of US banks — and what do they say about it?**

We look for three groups of words: **AI**, **Generative AI** (e.g. ChatGPT) and **Agentic AI** (AI agents that act on their own).

overview_how_to_read:
Use the sidebar to choose years and bank size. Each chart title gives the main result.
We count what banks *write* about AI, not what they *do*. Data: SEC EDGAR and FDIC (free public data).
caption_filings:
Number of bank 10-K reports per year: 337 in 2019, 277 in 2025.
2026 has only the reports filed so far.
data_filings:
**Data.** All 10-K reports of US commercial banks found with the SEC EDGAR search:
**2,425 reports from 387 banks** (2019–2026),
one report per bank per year. Savings banks, credit unions and private banks are not included.
data_method:
**How we find AI.** We split each report into sentences and keep the sentences with AI words.
We found **4,079 AI sentences** in 626 reports.
This is word counting: a bank can use AI and not write about it.
data_banks:
**Bank size:** total assets from the SEC — Community (< $10 bn) 265, Regional ($10–100 bn) 96, Large (> $100 bn) 25 banks.
**Location:** headquarters state and city from the SEC.
caption_waves: Line chart: % of bank 10-K reports that mention AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI, 2019–2026. AI: 2% in 2019, 88% in 2026. Generative AI: 49% in 2026. Agentic AI: 9% in 2026. Bars show 95% intervals. Dotted line = ChatGPT (Nov 2022).
caption_size: Line chart: % of 10-K reports that mention AI, by bank size, 2019–2026. In 2024: large banks 90%, community banks 31%. Bars show 95% intervals.
ts_findings:
**What we see**
- AI: **2%** of reports in 2019 → **88%** in 2026.
- Generative AI: first in 2021, now **49%**.
- Agentic AI: first in 2025, now **9%** — it is just starting.
- In 2024: 90% of large banks vs 31% of community banks.
caption_cloud: Word cloud of the 100 most used words in AI sentences; bigger word = used more often. The three largest: risks, services, models. Position and colour have no meaning.
caption_top: Bar chart: the 20 most used words in 4,079 AI sentences of bank 10-Ks, 2019–2026. Top three: risks, services, models. Common English words and the AI words themselves are removed.
caption_themes: Bar chart: % of AI sentences that contain words of each theme. Risk 50%, Customers & service 31%, Regulation & law 28%, Efficiency & operations 24%, Third-party vendors 20%, Cybersecurity & fraud 19%. One sentence can have several themes.
caption_keyness: Two diverging bar charts (log2 ratio). Words most typical for 2026 vs 2024: ai-driven, decision-making, operating. Typical for large banks: servicing, enhancements; for community banks: real, planned.
text_findings:
**What we see**
- Top words next to AI: **risks**, **services**, **models**.
- **50%** of AI sentences talk about **risk**.
- New in 2026: ai-driven, decision-making, operating.
- Large banks write more about servicing, enhancements; community banks about real, planned.
caption_net: Network of 196 banks. A line joins two banks whose AI sentences (2025–2026 reports) are similar; each bank is linked to its 3 most similar banks (cosine similarity ≥ 0.25). Colour = group found by the Louvain method (7 main groups, small groups in grey); overall modularity Q = 0.72, the value in brackets is each group's part of Q. Node size = number of AI sentences; orange ring = mentions agentic AI. 179 pairs of banks use almost the same AI text.
caption_vendors: Bar chart: number of banks that name each technology company in their latest 10-K. Microsoft 10, Fiserv 8, FIS 5, Jack Henry 5. Only 34 of 286 banks name any of the 15 companies.
network_findings:
**What we see**
- **196 banks** form **7 main groups** (Q = 0.72, clear groups).
- The largest group (20% of banks) uses the words *emerging, data, cybersecurity*.
- **179 pairs** of banks use almost the same AI text — often copied legal wording.
- Most connected banks: Peoples Financial Services Corp., Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc., Old Point Financial Corp.
- Only **34 of 286** banks name a technology company (Microsoft is first).
caption_map: Choropleth map of US states (Albers USA, equal-area). Colour = % of banks whose latest 10-K mentions Generative AI, 5 quantile classes (YlGnBu). Median state 50%; highest HI 100%, lowest MD 0%. Grey = no public bank or fewer than 3 banks (18 states).
map_findings:
**What we see**
- AI is everywhere now: in the median state **92%** of banks mention AI.
- Generative AI shows the differences: from **0%** (MD) to **100%** (HI).
- **25 banks** already write about agentic AI.
- Many states have only a few banks, so their % can change a lot.
overview_findings:
**Key findings**
1. **AI is everywhere:** 2% of reports in 2019 → **88%** in 2026.
2. **Big banks first:** in 2024, 90% of large vs 31% of community banks.
3. **AI = risk:** 50% of AI sentences talk about risk.
4. **Similar text:** 7 groups of banks; 179 pairs use almost the same words.
5. **Next step:** 9% of 2026 reports mention **agentic AI** (25 banks).
notes_limits:
**Limits**
- We count words, not actions.
- Only banks that sell shares file a 10-K, so most small private banks are missing.
- Word lists and network settings are our choices; other choices give a slightly different picture.
